datasets.name: Sentinel-2A multispectral imagery
datasets.verbatim: Sentinel-2A images from October 11, 2021, with less than 0.1% cloud cover, were downloaded from the ESA website (https:// scihub. coper nicus. eu)

datasets.name: Landslide inventory map of the study area
datasets.verbatim: The polygon of the landslides was georeferenced in QGIS software to produce a landslide inventory map of the study area and roughly validate this on the geohazard map.

methods.name: Semi-automatic classification plugin (SCP)
methods.summary: The SCP is a QGIS plugin that provides a semi-automatic workflow for remote sensing image classification. It includes tools for downloading imagery, pre-processing (clipping, reflectance conversion), and performing both unsupervised (ISODATA/K-means) and supervised (Random Forest) classification based on user-defined training samples (ROIs).
methods.source: Congedo, L. (2021). Semi-automatic classification plugin: a python tool for the download and processing of remote sensing images in QGIS. J Open Sour Softw Mag 6:3172.
methods.verbatim: The open-source, semi-automatic classification plugin (SCP) developed by Congedo [31], primarily provides a means to perform an unsupervised and supervised classification through an image processing technique... The SCP is a Python tool for downloading and processing remote sensing images [31], which was developed in the QGIS environment [32].

availability.author_statement: All data generated or analyzed during this study are included in this published article.

reproducibility_assessment: Sentinel-2A imagery is publicly accessible via the provided link, but the landslide inventory created by the authors is not referenced or linked. The Semi-automatic classification plugin is a well-known open-source tool, but no specific repository or link to the authors' custom implementation or workflow configuration is provided.
